Putin Orders 72-Hour Pause in Kyiv Strikes Amid US Envoy Visit

Russian President Vladimir Putin has ordered a 72-hour pause in strikes on Kyiv. The announcement came as US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow for talks, with plans to travel to the Ukrainian capital next. The pause is intended to facilitate peace talks. This development occurs amidst intensified aerial attacks by both Russian and Ukrainian forces. The Kremlin spokesperson confirmed the pause to Tass news agency, stating it would begin at midnight.
